verdict.rationale: Jules documents a public API (API keys, sessions, messaging, plan approval), so the versioning and deprecation axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions API version identifiers, version lifecycle, or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec showing versioning either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
